name: population_belauri
notes: EXP-016 Belauri-scale population-aware sensor design (real geography; synthetic emissions, meteorology and population fixtures). Interior candidate table only (54 sites at 1500 m): EXACT enumeration of every weighted design objective at budgets <= search.exact_max_budget, swap search + random restarts (best found, not provably optimal) above; greedy layouts are recorded and ALSO evaluated on test. Design ensemble seed 101 / validation 202 are the Phase 2 ensembles (declared reuse, so the area greedy layout can be regression-checked against results/geodesign/layouts.csv); test seed 305 / noise 3500 and the fixture draw seeds are fresh. alpha and the noise scale are frozen from the Phase 2 files and cross-checked on the validation ensemble. 'run' and 'pilot' select what a profile executes and are not part of the frozen hash.

mesh.note: 500 m / dt 100 is the EXP-016 default; EXP-015 stage 2 decides whether decisions are stable at this mesh. If it names a finer one, change these two keys (and nothing else) BEFORE any run and record it in the decision/finding.
